# Lumia Dental — AI Context Summary
> Where Cutting Edge Dentistry Meets A Modern Patient Experience in Lower Manhattan, NYC

## Practice Summary
Lumia Dental PLLC is an elevated multidisciplinary dental practice located at 160 Broadway, Suite 1004, New York, NY 10038 (Financial District / Lower Manhattan).
Phone / Text: (212) 287-1275 | Email: info@lumiadental.com | Web: https://www.lumiadental.com

Transit: 2 min walk from Fulton Center (A,C,J,Z,2,3,4,5) and 1 min walk from Cortlandt St (R,W).

## Key Specialties
- Cosmetic Dentistry & Porcelain Veneers (Custom Lumineers, aesthetic smile makeovers, tooth bonding)
- Invisalign® Clear Aligners (Top 1% Diamond Provider Dr. Adam Goodman, iTero 3D digital simulation)
- Pediatric Dentistry (Board-Certified Pediatric Specialist Dr. Monica Lobo, infant to adolescent care)
- Dental Implants & Periodontics (Board-Certified Periodontist Dr. Vandeep Bagga, laser gum therapy)
- Microscopic Endodontics (Root Canal Specialist Dr. Raven Drummond, urgent tooth pain relief)
- Restorative Dentistry (Bio-compatible tooth-colored ceramic crowns and composite bonding)
- Preventive Dental Hygiene (Ultrasonic cleanings, low-radiation digital radiography)

## The 3 Lumia Pillars
1. Convenience: Effortless digital scheduling, text messaging, online payments, and direct mobile communication.
2. Cutting Edge: Ivy-League clinicians (Tufts, UPenn, Columbia, NYU, Temple), 3D iTero intraoral scanners, laser therapy.
3. Comfort: Boutique relaxed sanctuary with ceiling 4K TVs with Netflix, noise-canceling headphones, and gentle bedside manner.
